tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary actions and active elements (near-black pill buttons). As text: 16.5:1 on `background`, 18.1:1 on `surface`, 15.2:1 on `surface-sunk`. As a fill, label it with `on-primary` (18.1:1). Also the keyboard focus ring.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of anything painted in `primary` — never a second primary colour. `on-primary` on it is 11.4:1.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on `primary` / `primary-hover` / `error` fills (18.1:1 / 11.4:1 / 5.6:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Selection and "you" fill: selected chips, the current step, the location pill. Label it with `on-accent`. Never text or icons on a light ground — only 1.2:1 against `background` — so an accent fill always needs a text label or an outline.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on `accent` fills (9.6:1).

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The main app canvas — a soft light grey.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, modals and input backgrounds, on top of `background`. Cards carry no border or shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells, the segmented-control track and disabled fills — a step below `background`.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and primary body text on `background` (16.5:1), `surface` (18.1:1) and `surface-sunk` (15.2:1); 14.5:1 or better on every tint.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, descriptions and section labels on `background` (5.2:1), `surface` (5.7:1) and `surface-sunk` (4.8:1); 4.6:1 or better on every tint.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers only: 1.2:1 on `background`, 1.3:1 on `surface`. Never the only boundary of a control — use `border-strong` for that.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input outlines and other control boundaries: 3.1:1 on `background`, 3.5:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Successful outcomes. Always paired with an icon or word. As text: 4.7:1 on `background`, 5.1:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution. Always paired with an icon or word. As text: 5.8:1 on `background`, 6.3:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. Always paired with an icon or word. As text: 5.1:1 on `background`, 5.6:1 on `surface`; as a fill, label it with `on-primary` (5.6:1).

tokens.name: tint-coffee
tokens.usage: Category tint for coffee — card gradients only. `text` 16.2:1, `text-muted` 5.2:1 on it.

tokens.name: tint-cold
tokens.usage: Category tint for cold drinks — card gradients only. `text` 14.8:1, `text-muted` 4.7:1 on it.

tokens.name: tint-food
tokens.usage: Category tint for food — card gradients only. `text` 15.7:1, `text-muted` 5.0:1 on it.

tokens.name: tint-bakes
tokens.usage: Category tint for bakes — card gradients only. `text` 14.5:1, `text-muted` 4.6:1 on it.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero title. One per page; scales fluidly from 48px to 92px.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles and hero headings. One per page; around 32px on small screens.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick a challenge, set a timer and ship a solution before it runs out.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary labels and timestamps. The smallest size for essential information.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels above groups of content. Set in `text-muted` by the style itself.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps and micro adjustments.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Compact element spacing.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding and small card gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard padding and content gaps — the default gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding and section spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding and large component gaps.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Major section separation and page layout.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Square corners for full-bleed images and tables that run edge to edge.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Small controls and badges.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Small elements nested inside cards, such as thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Inputs.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus and image tiles nested inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-5
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Large cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and circles — buttons, segmented controls, chips, avatars.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Every outline and divider: secondary buttons, inputs, badges, dividers. Cards have none.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline on every interactive element, drawn in `primary` with a 2px offset.
